description: Explain one fallow issue type without running analysis. Returns the rule id, name, rationale, worked example, fix guidance, and docs URL as JSON. Use this before applying fixes when an agent or reviewer needs to understand what a finding means. If your client exposes MCP resources, `fallow://explain/{issue_type}` serves the same document as a cacheable resource read.

issue_type.description:
Issue type or rule id to explain, for example "unused-export",
"fallow/unused-dependency", "high-complexity", or "code-duplication".

name: fallow_explain
